messages:
emily: Quick flag from support — customers are confused because the autoscale examples in Dedicated docs are YAML-only, but the Console export/import and the API expect JSON. Docs show `autoscale_policy:` as YAML and include anchors, which we can't round-trip. anyone seen this?

rick: oof. i remember we intentionally added YAML because it looked nicer, but if the tooling only accepts JSON that's a problem. good catch. can you paste the exact example?

emily: the snippet under Provisioning quickstart: 
```yaml
autoscale_policy:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 50
  metrics:
    - type: rps
      target: 1000
  max_burst: 200
```
The Console copy shows `{"metrics":[{"type":"rps","target":1000}]}` when exported.

jamal: i'll own converting examples to show both YAML and JSON. also add a note: Console/import expects strict JSON (no comments or anchors). i'll open a PR and include a curl API example.

tara: +1. can we also add a tiny CLI and terraform snippet? Support gets asked about "how do i provision a reserved pool with terraform?" all the time. i can draft the TF resource.

link-checker-bot: Link-check: broken anchor found in /docs/dedicated/provisioning.md -> #autoscale-policy-examples (404).

jamal: thanks bot. i'll fix anchors. adding also a migration note about SDK param rename: `reserved_tier` -> `capacity_profile`. customers migrating from older SDKs have been tripped up. include an inline diff example.

emily: that diff would be handy. example I suggested for migration: 
```diff
-client = DedicatedClient(reserved_tier="m5-reserved")
+client = DedicatedClient(capacity_profile="reserved-m5")
```
Please add it near the top of migration guide.

rick: PR #2210 opened: convert autoscale examples to JSON + YAML side-by-side, add curl and CLI examples, fix anchor. tagging @tara for TF snippet and @jamal for migration note. summary in PR body.

tara: drafting terraform snippet now. will keep it minimal and include billing note. draft: 
```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "reserved" {
  name = "prod-reserved"
  capacity_profile = "reserved-m5"
  region = "us-west-2"
  commit_term = "monthly"
  autoscale_policy = jsonencode({ min_replicas = 2, max_replicas = 50, max_burst = 100 })
}
```
Add a comment about needing org-level billing commit.

jamal: perfect. i'll add a short explanation about eviction behavior beneath the SLA table: when reserved pool gets evicted (capacity reclaimed for infra), traffic falls fall back to shared pool. example metrics observed: 95p latency increase ~1.8x and throughput not guaranteed. recommend `autoscale_policy.max_burst` and model pinning as mitigations.

emily: can we add an ASCII flow for the fallback logic? quick sketch: 
```
[User] -> [Reserved Pool] --evicted--> [Shared Pool / Fallback Variant]
```
That helped support folks.

rick: CI passed for docs PR: build preview at https://deploy-preview/redwood/docs/dedicated/2210. please review.

link-checker-bot: Link-check: all links in branch feat/docs/dedicated-2210 OK.

emily: reviewed and left 3 tiny comments (wording on billing note, add region hint in TF snippet, and prefer `capacity_profile` naming everywhere).

jamal: addressed comments and pushed. also added a short JSON API example for creating a pool: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/dedicated/pools \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"prod-reserved","capacity_profile":"reserved-m5","region":"eu-west-1","autoscale_policy":{"min_replicas":2,"max_replicas":50}}'
```

tara: added the TF snippet and a one-line terraform import note: `terraform import redwood_dedicated_pool.reserved <pool-id>`

emily: LGTM. can we also include a short note in the SLA table about "isolation semantics": isolated (hard isolation) vs soft isolation (best-effort, shared fallback) and list what triggers fallback (eviction for infra, overcommit, region outage)?

jamal: added a new column 'isolation' with values: isolated, soft-fallback and a brief bullet list of triggers + recommended mitigations (canary, fallback model, burst).

rick: merged PR #2210 into main. i'll create a redirect for the old anchor and update the docs index.

emily: thanks everyone. i'll follow-up to confirm internal support KB updated. closing thread once redirect is live. :rocket:

link-checker-bot: Action: created redirect /docs/dedicated#autoscale-policy-examples -> /docs/dedicated/provisioning#autoscale-policy (expires 30d).
